<h3>Retratos y privacidad</h3><p>Los ret:
Portraits and privacy

The game paints the portraits itself with see-through patches of colour, like watercolour: there are no photos. The names and portraits of the four fixed players are encrypted with the password. Without it, the page doesn't have them and they can't be seen even in the code. Free places are saved only on your device and the others see them when you're in the room.
